European Association located in the heart of Brussels. 

Jobomschrijving

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Support the team to organise workshops and events,

Prepare meetings and events material,

Take care of communication actions, updating websites, registrations, newsletters, etc.

Support team members to fulfil the association's role in the EU-funded projects (timesheets, drafting and submitting reports, etc.).

Archiving documents, updating CRM, and other administration tasks.

Support the team in other ad-hoc assignments related to the day-to-day activities of the association. 

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS 

Degree in communication, administration, project management or related studies. 

Experience in a similar position.

Should be able to work autonomously with little supervision.

Should be well organised, flexible and open-minded. 

Should be able to set priorities, follow strict deadlines, be proactive 

Should have good IT skills (Outlook, Office 365) and communication tools knowledge & understanding 

Knowledge and experience within the European context in Brussels would be highly considered. 

Very good writing and communication skills and a sense of diplomacy. 

Excellent spoken and written English.

Our client is an international organisation specialising in rail transport.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a little experience in communications and you are looking for experience in an international environment? We're looking for you for a 5-month project (ASAP - Early October) !

Main mission 

The candidate will be responsible for assisting the Communication Officer in the creation and integration of content on their website.

Receive briefings and requests for content creation from the various stakeholders in the organisation

Plan the copy work and communicate clear deadlines to the stakeholders, taking into account potential back-and-forth and validation.

Create content in line with the Thalys tone of voice and internal processes, taking account of SEO constraints

Ensuring that the content is validated by the various stakeholders before being sent to the translators

Reviewing the content once it has been translated and integrating it into our CMS according to the production process

Profile 

Bilingual in French and English, both spoken and written

At least two years' experience in copywriting and content integration in drupal

Very good knowledge of the CMS

Good knowledge of digital marketing, copywriting and SEO

Personality: customer-oriented, creative, proactive, autonomous, good writing and communication skills, good organisational skills, team player

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English
 
• You have a VCA certificate or are willing to obtain one

YOUR PROFILE
 

Distrilog is always looking for motivated employees who want to be part of our growing family.
 

Do you have an interest or experience in the logistics sector? Are you not afraid to work in a cool or cold environment? Are you looking for a job in the evening shift in Londerzeel? Then read on, apply, and make sure you're in the driver's seat of your dream job in no time!
 

YOUR TASKS
 

 
• As a versatile warehouse worker at Distrilog, you will have a wide range of responsibilities, including:
 
• unloading, checking, and sorting goods;
 
• processing orders using a handheld scanner;
 
• transporting goods using an electric or manual pallet truck;
 
• bringing prepared orders to the correct loading dock.
 
• In addition, you have an eye for cleanliness, and keeping the warehouse tidy is also part of your duties. 

 
 

PROFILE
 

 
• You have at least 2 consecutive years of experience in a warehouse or logistics environment and a stable professional track record.
 
• Your colleagues and supervisor can rely on you.
 
• You work accurately, ensuring customers always receive the correct order.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch, French, or English.
 
• Commuting daily to Londerzeel with your own transport is no problem for you.
 
• You are punctual, motivated, and a hard worker.
 
• You work from 13:14 to 21:30.
 
• You are willing to work in a refrigerated environment (2°C).
 
• You are willing to work on Saturdays.

jobs.description:
Do you hold a CE driving licence and and Code 95 ? Then you might be the person we are looking for!
 

In this role, you will deliver various materials with your truck (and unload them yourself) at construction sites or at customers’ premises.
 

 
• You transport goods correctly and safely to the customer.
 
• You load and unload the goods independently using your truck-mounted forklift.
 
• You work closely together with the transport planner.
 
• You communicate correctly and in a friendly manner with customers and ensure accurate administrative follow-up. 

 
• You hold a valid CE driving licence and Code 95.
 
• You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English.
 
• You take care of the equipment you work with.
 
• You are a reliable driver with a strong focus on safety.
 
• You are polite and helpful towards customers.
 
• You remain calm and courteous in traffic.
 
• You are punctual, including with administrative tasks (CMRs, trip sheets, etc.).
 
• You are responsible and able to work independently.

Our client is a globally recognised industrial organisation with a strong reputation for innovation, operational excellence and customer-centricity. With an international footprint and a collaborative culture, the company invests heavily in employee development and continuous learning.Employees benefit from a dynamic working environment where knowledge sharing, professional growth and teamwork are highly valued, creating opportunities to build a rewarding long-term career.

Jobomschrijving

• Partner with management to identify training needs and develop tailored learning solutions.
• Design, create and continuously improve training materials, manuals, guides and digital learning content.
• Deliver engaging training sessions for both new hires and existing employees.
• Evaluate training effectiveness and implement improvements where needed.
• Maintain training records and monitor employee learning progress.
• Provide individual coaching and ongoing support to customer service professionals.
• Support the implementation of learning and development initiatives across the organisation.
• Research and introduce modern training methodologies and best practices.
• Contribute to various projects related to employee development and organisational learning.
• Travel occasionally to other company sites to facilitate training sessions.

• Master's degree in Business, Education, Human Resources or a related field.
• Previous experience as a Trainer, Learning & Development Specialist, Facilitator or similar role.
• Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
• Proven ability to adapt training approaches to different audiences and topics.
• Experience developing learning content and training programmes.
• Familiarity with e-learning platforms and digital learning tools is an advantage.
• Excellent organisational and time management skills.
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to motivate and engage others.
• Ability to work independently while thriving in a collaborative environment.
• Fluent in English.
• Willingness to travel occasionally when required

Our client is a fast-growing organization active in the financial services sector. As part of its continued expansion, the company is investing heavily in digital transformation initiatives aimed at harmonizing processes, improving operational efficiency, and supporting the adoption of innovative technologies, including AI.

Jobomschrijving

As a Business Analyst, you will play a key role in the group's digital transformation journey. Working closely with business stakeholders and digital teams, you will analyze existing ways of working, identify improvement opportunities, and support the implementation of new tools and processes across multiple entities.This position is ideal for someone with a background in accounting or finance who has developed a strong interest in technology, process optimization, and digital transformation.Key responsibilities

• Analyze and document business processes across different entities.
• Identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, and automation.
• Gather and challenge business requirements from key stakeholders.
• Act as the bridge between end-users, operational teams, and digital experts.
• Support the implementation and adoption of new digital solutions.
• Drive change management and promote best practices across the organization.
• Help users leverage new technologies and AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude.
• Provide training and guidance to internal teams on digital tools and new ways of working.
• Monitor user feedback and propose continuous improvements.

• 3 to 5 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, Functional Analyst or Digital Transformation Consultant.
• Alternatively, experience in accounting combined with strong exposure to digital tools and process improvement.
• Knowledge of accounting and financial workflows.
• Familiarity with accounting software or digital finance solutions is a strong advantage.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Curious about technology, AI, and innovation.
• Hands-on mindset and willingness to work in a fast-growing environment.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.Key ResponsibilitiesGovernance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.
Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.
Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.
HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.
Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.
External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

ProfileWe are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

Our client is a global market leader operating within complex international supply chains. From a strategic logistics hub in Belgium, the company manages large-scale transportation flows across Europe and continues to invest in the growth of its rail logistics operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate and monitor daily rail transportation activities across Europe.
• Manage transport disruptions, delays, and operational escalations.
• Act as the main point of contact between internal stakeholders and external transport partners.
• Monitor wagon availability, utilization, and transport capacity.
• Support sourcing of additional transport capacity when required.
• Prepare operational reports and track logistics KPIs.
• Follow up transport costs, documentation, and invoicing processes.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree.
• Initial experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or a related field is a plus.
• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data and Excel.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable operating in a dynamic international environment.
• Fluent English is required.

jobs.occupation: Inventory and Materials Specialist EMEA - Region of Ghent
jobs.description:
Our client is an international industrial organisation with a strong global presence and a reputation for delivering high-quality products and services to customers worldwide. The company operates in a dynamic manufacturing environment and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to strategic operational excellence projects within an international setting.

Jobomschrijving

As Inventory & Materials Planner EMEA you will be responsible for following tasks:

• Monitor and coordinate inventory levels across the EMEA region to support customer demand and service objectives
• Analyse inventory performance and identify opportunities for optimisation of finished goods and component stock
• Prepare and present inventory reporting for global inventory reviews and stakeholder meetings
• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Logistics and Operations teams to improve inventory strategies and delivery performance
• Monitor stock availability, out-of-region shipments and on-time delivery performance, while proposing corrective actions where needed
• Support forecasting, inventory planning and replenishment processes through data analysis and reporting
• Contribute to the development and improvement of inventory policies, procedures and best practices

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience within Supply Chain, Procurement, Sourcing, Logistics or Operations
• You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in inventory management, materials planning, production planning or supply chain coordination
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify optimisation opportunities and drive improvements
• Excellent Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems
• Strong communication skills and capable of interacting with international stakeholders at different levels
• Fluent in English; additional languages are considered an advantage
• Autonomous, proactive and able to take ownership in a fast-paced international environment
